verdict.rationale: The evidence covers only outbound vendor due diligence: sending security questionnaires to vendors and uploading questionnaire templates. Nothing shows importing questionnaires that customers send in SIG, CAIQ, portal or spreadsheet form, or exporting answers back in the customer's original format. Vendor-side questionnaire sending is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for this inbound sales story.

support.subject: As a sales lead, questionnaires arrive in every shape — SIG, CAIQ, portals, spreadsheets — and the platform imports and exports them in the format the customer sent
